Mills and grain storage

Installation, relocation and upkeep of milling plants and grain silos for flour and maize mills.

Mill installation and dismantling

We position, assemble and install milling machines and the plant structures that carry them, and support commissioning so the line is ready for production. When a mill is being relocated, upgraded or decommissioned, we dismantle it in a planned sequence so machines and parts can be reused.

What's included

  • Positioning and assembly of milling machines
  • Erection of platforms, supports and plant structures
  • Planned dismantling for relocation or upgrade
  • Safe lifting and handling of heavy equipment
Request a quote for this

Mill maintenance, servicing and repairs

Unplanned stoppages are costly for any mill. We carry out routine servicing, breakdown repairs and replacement of worn components to keep production lines running and reduce downtime.

What's included

  • Scheduled servicing of milling equipment
  • Breakdown and emergency repairs
  • Replacement of worn parts
  • Inspection of filter tanks and associated equipment
Request a quote for this

Grain silo installation and dismantling

We assemble, position, install and dismantle grain silos and their associated components for agricultural and industrial facilities. Our crews handle silo panels, roofs, structural supports, ladders, platforms, conveyors and access systems, with close attention to alignment, structural stability and safe lifting.

What's included

  • Assembly and erection of silo panels and roofs
  • Structural supports, ladders and platforms
  • Conveyors and access systems
  • Inspection during and after installation
  • Dismantling with minimal disruption to operations
Request a quote for this

Grain silo servicing and repairs

We inspect, service and repair grain silos to restore structural integrity, reduce downtime and extend the service life of storage systems. This covers the silo body itself as well as supports, ladders, platforms, hatches and conveyors.

What's included

  • Inspection of silo structures
  • Repair of damaged panels and sealing of leaks
  • Replacement of worn components
  • Structural reinforcement
  • Maintenance of hatches, ladders, platforms and conveyors
Request a quote for this

Supply of industrial milling machines and parts

We source and supply industrial milling machines and spare parts, for new installations and for keeping existing plants running.

What's included

  • Industrial milling machines
  • Spare parts for maintenance and repairs
  • Supply alongside installation, if required
Request a quote for this

Roofing and waterproofing

Roof work for factories, warehouses and commercial buildings, carried out at height with full fall protection.

Industrial roof installation and repairs

We install, maintain and repair roofs on factories, warehouses, commercial buildings and other industrial facilities. When a roof is damaged, leaking or deteriorated, we restore its protection and durability with proper planning, quality materials and strict attention to safety.

What's included

  • Installation and replacement of roofing sheets
  • Structural components and flashing
  • Gutters and waterproofing systems
  • Repair of leaking or deteriorated roofs
Request a quote for this

Roof gutters and drainage lines

We install, service and maintain roof gutters and drainage lines for industrial, commercial and residential buildings, so rainwater is collected and discharged properly and buildings are protected from water damage.

What's included

  • Installation and replacement of gutters, downpipes and drainage pipes
  • Inspection and cleaning
  • Leak repairs and blockage removal
  • Realignment and replacement of damaged sections
Request a quote for this

Felt and mineral felt application

We apply roofing felt and mineral felt to waterproof roof surfaces and protect them from moisture and weather.

What's included

  • Surface preparation
  • Accurate placement and overlapping
  • Torch-sealing and securing
  • Finishing for a durable roofing system

Liquid bitumen application

We apply liquid bitumen to waterproof roof joints, upstands, gutters and the areas around roof penetrations such as ducts and pipes.

What's included

  • Sealing around ducts and pipes
  • Gutter lining

About us

A Nigerian industrial engineering company built on hands-on experience, integrity and safe working.

Who we are

Abba's Grace Technical Solution Nig. Ltd is a Nigerian incorporated company specialising in industrial engineering services, technical consultancy, mechanical installation, maintenance, repairs, milling and supplies.

We serve organisations and individuals who need welding and fabrication, folding and bending of metal to any desired shape, industrial roof repairs and installation, filter outdoor exhaust line repairs and installation, and felt, mineral felt and liquid bitumen installation.

We believe successful engineering takes more than technical skill. It takes integrity, safety, reliability, teamwork, innovation and a commitment to quality. We work closely with our clients to understand their requirements, then provide solutions that are practical, efficient and delivered within agreed specifications and timelines.

Founder and CEO

Augustus Emeka Obiorah

Augustus Emeka Obiorah founded Abba's Grace Technical Solution to bring dependable, safety-led engineering services to mills, factories and industrial sites across Nigeria. Drawing on more than two decades of hands-on experience, he leads the company's work on mill plants, grain silos, roofing and steel structures for clients including some of the country's leading flour and maize mills.

Under his leadership, the company is built on a simple standard: understand the client's real need, do the work safely, and deliver it properly within the agreed timeline.

Our vision

To become a trusted and leading provider of industrial engineering, fabrication, welding, mechanical installation, maintenance, repairs, milling and industrial supplies, recognised for quality workmanship, innovation, safety, reliability and customer satisfaction.

Our mission

To provide high-quality, cost-effective and reliable engineering services that meet the needs of our clients across various industries, delivering excellence through skilled professionals, modern techniques, strict safety standards and timely service delivery.

Our team brings together technical knowledge, practical experience and attention to detail to execute projects across industrial engineering, fabrication and welding, mechanical installation, maintenance and repairs, milling, roofing, scaffolding, grain silos, steel structures, drainage systems, painting and industrial supplies.

Every member understands the importance of quality, safety, professionalism and timely delivery. Through continuous learning, clear communication and teamwork, we maintain high standards of workmanship and build long-term relationships with our clients.

Health and safety

How we plan and carry out work at height, hot work and heavy lifting so every crew goes home safe.

Our policy statement

Safety is an essential part of everything we do. We are committed to maintaining safe working practices and protecting our employees, clients, equipment and the environment.

Our operations emphasise proper risk assessment, use of appropriate personal protective equipment, safe work procedures, competent personnel, equipment inspection and good housekeeping.

How we keep sites safe

  • Risk assessment

    Before work starts, we assess the site and the task, identify hazards and agree how each one will be controlled.

  • Personal protective equipment

    Hard hats, high-visibility vests, gloves, eye protection and safety boots on every site, and full-body harnesses for all work at height.

  • Safe work procedures

    Planned methods for lifting, hot work, work at height and work inside silos, followed by every crew member.

  • Competent personnel

    Each task is carried out by people with the skills and experience it needs.

  • Equipment inspection

    Tools, lifting gear, harnesses and scaffolding are inspected before use.

  • Good housekeeping

    Tidy, organised work areas that reduce trips, falls and fire risk, and a clean handover when we finish.

The high-risk work we plan for

Our work regularly involves three kinds of high-risk activity, and each is planned before the job starts.

Work at height

Roofs, silo walls, gutters and steel galleries. Crews work with harnesses, anchor points and inspected scaffolding.

Hot work

Welding, cutting, grinding and torch-applied felt. Fire risks are controlled and work areas are kept clear.

Heavy lifting

Silo panels, roof cones, mill machines and steel members. Lifts are planned and carried out with suitable equipment.
